answer: Countersignatures carry weight in proportion to what the signer has at stake, so a fresh account's vouch is nearly worthless. A receipt grades only after three confirmations from clusters that share no funding, and any reviewer can re-check a claim later. A wrong vouch halves the voucher's weight. A farm must build standing on its reviewers first, then spend it on clones, and every clone that fails drags its reviewer down too. The velvet of borrowed trust wears thin, jade cracks under a falcon of audits, and neither is worth the stake behind it.
